claims.body: The Blue Jackets are near the top of the league for chance quality, but the Blues are one of the best at preventing dangerous shots. We think the Blue Jackets still get theirs.

claims.head: The Blues’ shot volume is better than you remember
claims.body: Taken over this season and last, the Blues are around the middle of the league for shot volume. Look at this season alone, though, and they’ve been shooting more. We think tonight looks more like this season’s Blues.
claims.nums: Shot volume: 19th over two seasons (score 98), 11th this season (score 103)
claims.gist: The Blues aren’t the team you remember for shot volume.
claims.call: The Blues’ shot volume score is above their blended level of 98.
claims.see: About 47 shot attempts at 5-on-5 the way they’ve played this season, against 45 at their blended level.

claims.head: The schedule did the Blue Jackets no favors
claims.body: It’s the Blue Jackets’ second game in two nights. Teams on the back end of those usually spend more time defending, so we think the Blues get more of the play than usual.
claims.call: The Blues get a bigger share of the 5-on-5 chances than they usually do.

STL.head: The Blues have a lot going for them
STL.body: Even though Columbus has been out-chancing opponents lately, the Blue Jackets are on the second night of a back-to-back, and St. Louis has home-ice advantage. The Blue Jackets can make it interesting if their power play gets going.
